fact: Mali activated a fibre link with Senegal on 5 October 2026 and, per a 2023 World Bank diagnostic, already had 12 fibre links over seven international exit points reaching submarine cables via Côte d'Ivoire, Burkina Faso, Senegal, Guinea, Mauritania and Morocco.
title: Mali Expands International Internet Links, but Domestic Network Remains Fragile
